note: Newly built private RV park on the north side of Guttenberg, a few blocks inland from the Mississippi with the town between. Gravel lot beside a rail line. Travel Iowa lists both nightly and seasonal sites. --Claude
summary: Full hookups confirmed from Facebook; no rate, website or booking channel found; presence question flagged.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: PRICE: no posted rate anywhere. RV Life tag $$ (stored; not re-read, I couldn't find the park's RV Life page). A 10-16 search also found no pages, and a 10-17 Campendium try 404'd. PRESENCE: fails as I read the rule: no working website, only a public Facebook page (312 followers, 'Not yet rated (1 review)', page text 'A newly built full hookup RV campground') with phone (563) 880-6009; Google 5.0 / 5 reviews with the same phone and no website, under the 25 reviews needed. Open status not contradicted. GS: not in the cached Good Sam directory. GATEWAY: none within 40 km (Wisconsin Dells 142 km). So this entry stands only on phone and Facebook; AWH's call whether to keep or drop.

LONG-STAY TESTS: can't be run; no rate sheet or rules. Seasonal share: unknown. inclusion_evidence cites a Travel Iowa listing saying 'nightly and seasonal', which I did not re-read. Reviews quoted: none available (Google's 5 not opened). Operator leads with 'newly built full hookup RV campground', nothing about seasonal. Imagery shows about 30 RVs parked side by side on a gravel lot, which looks more like long-stay than transient, though one frame can't prove it.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront holds. A marsh adjoins the lot's northwest side and an algae-covered slough lies about 50 m southwest, behind vegetation, with open slough water about 200 m south. The Mississippi is on the far side of town.
UNREAD: Facebook posts and About beyond the login wall; I read only what shows logged out and didn't try another route.
